summary.result: Indirect esissions, such as electricity, heat and waste generation are separately estimated as well as direct emissions to help local government to establish substantial and implementable reduction measures of GHGs.
summary.background: In this study, GHG inventory on 17 local government between 2005 and 2014 is build up using ‘GHG emission estimation guideline (2016. 2) for local government’ developed and distributed by KECO.
